arguments.question: Assess whether commodity-linked inputs are material to ANET’s 5-, 21- and 63-session thesis, focusing narrowly on semiconductor/component availability, optical/interconnect inputs, manufacturing/logistics commitments and any pricing or margin channel supported by the supplied latest filing/results. Distinguish a true commodity-price exposure from broader component/supply-chain risk; do not infer quantified copper, energy or semiconductor sensitivity without issuer evidence. Deliver a concise mechanism, counter-explanation and observable review condition. Stop after the supplied issuer filing/results passages; if input weights, supplier commitments or price sensitivity are not disclosed, state that the commodity channel is unquantified and do not search further.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether commodities merit a distinct near-term downside/upside channel or should be treated only as an unquantified supply-chain qualifier in the final ANET assessment.
